issues.title: Hidden indicators take the clicks at the top-left of the screen
issues.note: Auto-hidden indicators are moved to -20000 and kept visible; 42.21 keeps top-level UI on the screen (ISUIElement:setX clamps to 0), so they pile up at 0,0, invisible, over the equipped-item icons: right-clicking the primary hand does nothing. The Studio's shim lets them leave the screen while hidden (patch modern_status). Checked in the game on 42.21, 2026-10-30: 22 indicators at 0,0, none after the patch.
issues.source: PZ Mod Studio, checked in the game on 42.21 (2026-10-30)
